concepts.title: Cottage lean-to
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: environment concept for Hearthbrew, landscape 16:10, one complete edge-to-edge scene. Blend BOTH reference images: image 1 is the current outdoor cottage garden, image 2 is the sunlit conservatory. Keep the current garden's cottage charm, open view toward woodland, lush border flowers, golden flagstones, pots and modest potting table; introduce the conservatory's beautiful sage-green timber framework, glass panes and overhead sunlight. Exactly ONE LARGE CONTINUOUS raised herb plot, made from chunky weathered sage-green wooden planks, honey-colored worn edges, square corner posts and golden nail heads. No inner partitions or paths through its soil. Convincing elevated first-person perspective: far/top corners closer together and far edge shorter than wide front edge. Plant believable groups of pale sage-like Moonleaf, copper-stemmed orange-flowered Emberroot, silvery slender-leaf herbs and purple bell flowers, with visible rich soil between clumps. Match the warm watercolor/gouache textures, delicate hand-ink contours, rounded storybook forms and detailed countryside illustration of both references. No people, hands, text, labels, UI, watermark or collage. VARIATION 1 — ATTACHED LEAN-TO. Preserve the current scene's almost straight-on view across the broad trapezoidal central herb bed. The cottage is on the LEFT, with its green arched door visible. A sloping glass lean-to roof grows directly out of that cottage wall, supported on three slender green posts along the RIGHT edge of the garden. The roof slopes from high left to lower right, its glass and rafters filling the upper third. The FRONT and RIGHT sides remain completely open to air, and beyond the low back stone wall are the flowering arch and woodland. A compact potting table stands at far right under the last roof bay. Intimate sheltered outdoor garden, distinctly only partially enclosed.
